memory_candidates.content: When a plan's final phase declares Verification Tier: full but a dispatch file carries a Batch Gate Deferral directive, and the phase's own touched files are specs/** task-management artifacts only (not source), neither run-all.sh --only nor verify-deploy.sh --only-gate can express the right scoped check. Use the directive's UNMAPPABLE CRITERION path: run the repo-specific check the plan's own Testing & Validation section already names directly (e.g. validate-artifact.sh <path> <type>) as the scoped discharge, and record in the summary/progress that the full gate set is deferred to the batch-level stage, not waived.
